Adds RegionSelectorController, ScreenshotCapturer, VisionClient, and extends HotkeyEventTap with double-tap detection. Trigger changed from double-click Option to double-tap Shift (commit 668f6e6); vision model changed from qwen2.5-vl to llava:7b (commit 52f8cfd).
features.evidence: All 94 tests pass including 5 new VisionClientTests. Build clean. New files: VisionClient.swift, VisionClientTests.swift, ScreenshotCapturer.swift, RegionSelectorController.swift, RegionSelectorOverlayView.swift. Modified: HotkeyEventTap.swift (double-click), RewriterFlow.swift (startFromScreenshot), PopupState.swift (.loadingScreenshot, .noTextInImage), Preferences.swift (visionModel), OwletApp.swift (wiring), ImprovePromptFloater.swift (loadingScreenshot rendering). BUGFIX 2026-05-29: double-tap trigger (now Shift, commit 668f6e6) never fired in-app — bare Shift emits CGEventType.flagsChanged, not keyDown, so detection in the keyDown branch was unreachable. Added .flagsChanged to event-tap mask; double-tap now detected via absent->present Shift transitions in HotkeyEventTap.decideModifierAction. 101/101 tests pass incl. 7 new HotkeyEventTapTests. MANUAL VERIFY PENDING: double-tap Shift → region selector opens. REWORK 2026-05-29: region selector overhauled — SwiftUI DragGesture (no onEnded; drags never completed) replaced with AppKit RegionSelectorView on a single union-of-all-screens RegionSelectorPanel (canBecomeKey). Adds: drag-to-select, Esc/right-click/click-without-drag to cancel, only-active-screen dim that follows the cursor, re-trigger toggles closed. ScreenshotCapturer now Retina/multi-display aware via unit-tested pixelCropRect. Removed Views/RegionSelectorOverlayView.swift. 105/105 tests pass (4 new ScreenshotCapturerTests). MANUAL VERIFY PENDING: drag/Esc/click-close/toggle/cross-screen-dim + open captured PNG to confirm correct region at full resolution (needs Screen Recording permission). MULTI-MONITOR FIX 2026-05-29: single union-spanning overlay window rendered the dim wrong on two screens (a window has one screen's scale/origin). Rewrote to one overlay window per NSScreen (screen-local coords, acceptsFirstMouse for drags on non-key screens, only cursor's screen dims, Esc via local+global NSEvent monitors removed in dismiss()). selectRegion() contract unchanged; ScreenshotCapturer + 4 tests untouched. 105/105 tests pass. features.name: Always-on inline autocomplete (AX-native fields)
features.description: Cotypist-style inline ghost text at the caret, default off behind Settings. Reads AX caret context + BoundsForRange, asks qwen2.5:1.5b via Ollama /api/generate, shows a click-through overlay, Tab accepts, Esc/typing dismisses, password fields excluded. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-01-owlet-autocomplete-design.md; plan: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-01-owlet-autocomplete.md.
features.evidence: CLOSED 2026-06-01 (pm) by user decision after visual confirmation in TextEdit (caret positioning 'seems ok', readable chip 'looks good'). HONEST SCOPE: positioning + the backdrop chip were confirmed by eye in TextEdit only; Tab accept-at-offset, Tab passthrough w/o suggestion, Esc/typing dismiss, password-field exclusion, Notes/WebKit positioning, and multi-monitor were DEFERRED, not verified — remaining coverage tracked under feat-015. isWebEditor Notes discriminator is a known dead end (stash@{0}). --- HISTORY --- Swift XCTest PASS on 2026-06-01: (cd Owlet && xcodebuild test -project Owlet.xcodeproj -scheme Owlet -destination platform=macOS) → 125/125 tests pass. Added AutocompleteController/Predictor/GhostTextOverlay, AX caret context + insertAtCaret, HotkeyEventTap Tab/Esc/text-change handling, Settings toggle/model picker. MANUAL VERIFY PENDING: TextEdit ghost text at caret, Tab insert/passthrough, p50 latency ≤ ~200 ms, password fields never predict, supported AX-native app list. COORDINATE FIX 2026-06-01: ghost text never appeared at the caret because AXBridge.readCaretContext returned the raw kAXBoundsForRange rect in Quartz space (top-left origin) and GhostTextOverlay used it as Cocoa coords (bottom-left origin) with no y-flip, so the overlay landed at the vertically mirrored position and the screen-clamp pinned it there. Fix: flip to Cocoa coords at the AXBridge boundary against the union of all screen frames' maxY (multi-monitor safe), plus a char-before-caret BoundsForRange fallback when the zero-length query returns an empty rect. Pure flip helper AXBridge.cocoaRect(fromAXRect:screenUnionMaxY:) unit-tested (3 new AXBridgeGeometryTests). Swift XCTest PASS: -only-testing AXBridgeGeometryTests + AutocompleteControllerTests → 9/9. MANUAL RESULT 2026-06-01, STILL BROKEN: on a single built-in Retina display the ghost appears but FAR from the caret. Ruled out model/enable/Ollama (autocomplete on, qwen2.5:1.5b returns completions, running build has the flip), so the flip alone is not the full story on one display. Added temporary 'caretgeom' diagnostic logging in AXBridge.caretCocoaRect (raw zero/char AX rects, union maxY, main frame, converted rect) to capture the real numbers. NEXT: type in TextEdit, read log show --predicate subsystem==co.greenpassport.owlet AND category==caretgeom --info, fix the caret-bounds-to-screen mapping, remove the diagnostic, then re-run the TextEdit check. See session-handoff.md 'Open bug'. LANDING PASS 2026-06-01: Swift suite 132/132 pass (xcodebuild test -scheme Owlet -destination platform=macOS, this session). Model-latency proxy via curl to Ollama /api/generate using Predictor's exact request shape (qwen2.5:1.5b, num_predict 12, temp 0.2, stop newline, keep_alive 24h) over 6 representative prefixes: warm p50=148ms p90=163ms max=164ms; cold/first-load 301ms (one-time, mitigated by keep_alive). NOTE: model latency ALONE — true end-to-end adds the 120ms debounce + AX caret read + overlay render, measurable only in the running app. R1 fragile assumption (tiny model ~150ms over Ollama) validated on the model term. Code now carries the WebKit/Notes AXTextMarker fallback + AXFrame rectIsNearAnchor validator — MORE complete than progress.md's 'NOT fixed' note (doc drift; resolve by VERIFYING in a real WebKit app, not assuming). Temp caretgeom diagnostic INTENTIONALLY LEFT IN per plan until visual smoke confirms positioning. REMAINING GATE (user-only, cannot run headless): ./install.sh -> re-grant Accessibility+Input Monitoring -> enable Autocomplete -> (1) TextEdit single-display: ghost lands AT caret, Tab inserts at correct offset, Tab w/o suggestion passes through, Esc/typing dismisses, password field never predicts; (2) Notes multi-monitor: ghost lands at caret (exercises textMarker + primary-maxY fix). If positioning off, capture: log show --predicate 'subsystem == "co.greenpassport.owlet" AND category == "caretgeom"' --info. On pass: remove the caretgeom diagnostic + flip status to done in the same commit. PARKED 2026-06-01 (two open bugs, both reproduced on the external monitor): (1) GHOST ONE LINE TOO HIGH in BOTH native (TextEdit, web=false) and Notes — a constant ~one-line vertical offset, NOT the earlier wrong-screen bug. Raw zero-length kAXBoundsForRange sample: rawZero on external, cocoa={{1400,2227},{0,17}}; overlay centers on caretScreenRect.midY yet renders one line above, so either the flip y is ~lineHeight too high or GhostTextOverlay.show vertical placement is off. Did NOT determine constant-vs-growing or built-in-vs-external scope before parking. (2) isWebEditor (AXWebArea ancestor scan) does NOT detect Notes — Notes logs web=false, so the AXWebArea discriminator is wrong for Notes' AX tree; native-only suppression via AXWebArea is a dead end, fall back to a bundle-id denylist or re-investigate Notes' role hierarchy. Experimental isWebEditor + rawZero/web= diagnostics stashed (git stash: 'feat-013 wip: isWebEditor gate + raw caret diagnostics'); committed tree still carries the original caretgeom diagnostic. Resume: decide overlay-vs-flip for bug (1) first (it blocks ALL apps incl. native), then revisit the web discriminator. features.name: Autocomplete coverage + controls

Cotabby), and a menu-bar pause toggle to silence always-on prediction (cf. Cotabby; Esc-dismiss already shipped in feat-013).

features.name: Cotypist extras
features.description: Phase 3 autocomplete extras: typo correction, emoji-on-colon, and local on-device frequency/vocab learning.

features.name: Permission explainer + first-run onboarding
features.description: Per-permission explainer UI (cf. Cotabby's privacy panel): on first run / from Settings, show exactly what each macOS grant does and why nothing leaves the Mac — Accessibility (read focused field + caret to place suggestions), Input Monitoring (detect typing + Tab accept), Screen Recording (region OCR for the screenshot-rewrite flow). Doubles as the fix for the most common 'why am I seeing no suggestions?' support case (missing grant / paused / no model). Trust surface, not core inference.

features.name: Bring-your-own model in Settings
features.description: Expose model choice as a first-class Settings picker for both autocomplete and rewriter, letting the user point Owlet at any locally available Ollama model rather than the bundled default. Settings already has a model picker (feat-003); this generalises it (list installed models, validate availability, persist per-role choice). cf. Cotabby's GGUF swap, adapted to Owlet's Ollama runtime.

features.name: Model tiers picker (fast vs sharp)
features.description: Offer a small set of speed/quality autocomplete tiers (cf. Cotabby's nano/mini/base/pro) so weaker Macs can trade quality for latency. GATED on feat-013's measured p50 latency data — the speed/quality curve isn't known until the latency gate runs, so this stays not-started until then. Builds on feat-018's model plumbing.

features.name: Apple Intelligence (FoundationModels) engine
features.description: Optional in-process inference backend via Apple's FoundationModels runtime (no Ollama, no model download) behind the existing Predicting protocol. macOS 26 + supported-hardware gate; falls back to the Ollama/MLX path when unavailable. Largest lift of the autocomplete extras and a real differentiator (cf. Cotabby's Apple Intelligence engine). Behind the Predicting protocol so it stays contained.
